description: AVX2 enabling study on one AMD EPYC 9575F allocation, class optimization, never publication evidence. Compare public VectorStore.search on 859,346 WikiText-103 training paragraphs in int8, 2 workers, k 10 and 8 queries per call. Two required cells: o1-d256-q8 and o2-d1024-q8. The 256 fixed STS-B test queries use PCG64 seed 0 and exclude store texts. Outputs must be bit-identical. Eight pairs in each A/A tuning, independent A/A validation, comparison and confirmation phase, approved by Oliver on 2026-11-10 instead of fifteen. One calibration tier only; no automatic retry or extension. cells@2 requires at least 10 percent saving in comparison and confirmation in both cells, alongside the existing noise, duration and execution-path checks. stop_early stops later cells after a measured rejection; stop_session_on_reject remains false. The study decision is provisional (final: false). Only the separate sealed allocation decide step can enable AVX2 after float32 correctness and both complete o2 candidate-child profiles. The allocation owns the 285-minute / 7.10 USD ceiling including setup and a 600-second collection reserve; --wall-time-seconds uses its remaining budget. No run is authorized by this file.
